body.text: My web and digital work spans content strategy, UX writing, information architecture, accessibility, and the practical craft of writing for screens — from long-form editorial adapted for digital audiences to microcopy, navigation labels, and structured content systems.

A note on professional work: Much of my recent corporate communications work was created within confidential environments and cannot be publicly reproduced. The examples presented here are therefore a combination of current web projects, selected professional work, and representative writing samples.

sections.label: Web Content & Copywriting
sections.description: Writing produced for digital platforms — web pages, landing pages, and content designed to inform, guide, and convert.

items.title: Refreshing a Digital Presence for an Evolving Business
items.description:
I have supported Career Ventures' website content through significant changes in the owner's business direction and target audience. In 2019, I refined the site's existing content and tone to present a more formal, corporate voice geared toward executives, while updating service pages and adding automated contact forms and Google search/listing capabilities.

More recently, as the business shifted its focus toward neurodivergent clients, particularly people with ADHD, I revisited the site's tone, imagery, and overall presentation to better support that direction. I also advised the owner on the potential value of social channels and AI-assisted blog development, while recognizing the importance of maintaining his subject-matter voice and involvement in the process.

items.title: From Print to Digital: Extending a Brand Online
items.description:
I was initially engaged by Hippocrates Children to design physical greeting cards and trade show materials. As I became involved in the broader marketing effort, I offered strategic recommendations on the brand's digital presence, which led to my taking responsibility for the company's Shopify website.

I learned the Shopify platform and underlying code to address a responsive logo-sizing issue and improve the site's presentation across screen sizes. I also introduced the client to AI-assisted image generation as a way to create studio-quality product photography for the greeting cards. I developed an initial prompt for her to use, then helped implement the resulting images by uploading and linking them throughout the site.

items.title: Giving an Artist's Work a Digital Voice
items.description:
Rob Westerberg engaged me to create a website to showcase his artwork. After interviewing him about his work and vision, I developed the site's brand and visual direction and created a gallery-style portfolio using GoDaddy Airo and its beta Website Creator.

The project involved translating an artist's personal vision into a concise digital identity and organizing his work into a straightforward portfolio experience designed to let the artwork take center stage.
